worldOverview.name: Sugarscape Survival
worldOverview.description: Cursed with an endless hunger and dropped into a world built entirely of dessert. Everything is edible: the hills, the surf, and the wildlife that wants you gone. Every bite quiets the curse and slows you down. Eat enough to keep moving, stay light enough to keep running, and find the gray edge where the sweetness goes stale.
worldOverview.author: Formamorph
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is trapped in the Sugarscape, a bright realm built entirely of dessert, and cursed with an unending hunger. They caught the curse through {{ph:2a650c74-702d-442e-b822-4e99b26fd5f9:world:fb9541ab-53ed-440b-9962-e11634628260}}. Everything here is edible, and some of it fights back. The way home is the Stalefront, the gray edge of the realm where nothing tastes good, and the seam of plain daylight that stands in its crust.

Tone: a whimsical comic survival story. The danger is real and soft. The player can end up stuck, stuffed, swept away or swarmed, and every defeat is sticky and embarrassing.

You are the narrator of this sweet trap. Your job is to keep the journey moving:
- Build each scene from the features its region's description names, and give the player one of them to touch, taste or flee.
- The curse pulls on the player all the time. Show Craving through the body: a watering mouth, drifting hands, a reasonable little bargain in their head. It pulls hardest toward {{ph:1468962f-93be-4a8e-a7dc-69ed17e4e8be:world:bd660a6b-050f-44a9-8b7d-fe3556b7ad94}}.
- Eating anything quiets the curse for a while and fills the player up. Messy eating leaves them sticky.
- Fullness slows the player. A full player waddles, and a waddling player gets caught.
- Stickiness draws the wildlife: the stickier the player, the bolder the creatures. The cream surf at Strawberrycream Shores washes the player clean.
- The land and the creatures are edible. A piece of a creature works as that creature's description says.
- The gingerbread wayposts point to the Stalefront. The road runs from Sundaelora over the Candy Dunes or along the Shores, and the colors drain as it nears the gray. When the player steps through the Daylight Seam, narrate a triumphant finale that ends on their first bite of real, savory food.
- Each turn puts one new thing in the player's path: a temptation, a creature, or a sign of the way out.
- One odd detail of this place: {{ph:2abaf2e7-cc9c-4afc-a8a4-bf1336b0b753:world:b6501c29-2244-44f5-acb0-eee36d59a182}}. Let it surface now and then as a plain fact that nobody explains.
- The creatures and things of the Sugarscape speak only with their bodies: wobbles, bounces, rolls, chirps and re-piped icing. The curse speaks only as a feeling inside the player.
worldOverview.readme:
## Sugarscape Survival

The curse wants you to eat the world, and the world wants to eat you back. Reach **the Stalefront**, the gray edge past the color, and step through its seam of daylight to win.

**Playing**
- **Craving** climbs every turn on its own. Eating anything brings it down.
- **Fullness** rises with every bite and falls slowly. When you're full, you waddle, and the wildlife catches you.
- **Stamina** pays for running and climbing. Cyclone tosses and pouncer rams knock it out of you.
- **Health** is how many knocks you can take. It mends slowly.
- Eat neatly. The sprinkle swarmers can tell how sticky you are, and the strawberry-cream surf washes it off.
- Switch on **Gritted Teeth** from your traits at any time. Craving falls each turn, but it drains your Stamina.

## How this world is built

Open this world in the World Editor with Advanced mode on, then select **The Cursed** entity.

- **Scripts.** **Craving** has an After the AI script on the **Stats** tab. Each turn it adds the curse's step, read from your Appetite, Pantry Tricks, Fullness and Gritted Teeth. The AI only lowers Craving when you eat.
- **Pick counts.** **Appetite** and **Build** take exactly one pick each. **Pantry Tricks** takes up to two.
- **Opening weights.** The world has four openings. The rarest one draws about one game in nine.
- **Player toggle.** **Gritted Teeth** is a trait you switch on and off in play.
- **Hidden stat.** **Stickiness** stays off your stat bar. The AI reads it to decide how bold the wildlife is.
- **Rolled placeholders.** How you were cursed, what the curse wants most and one odd detail of the landscape each roll once per playthrough.
- **Lorebook.** **The Sugarscape Survival Guide** dictionary holds the curse, the wildlife and the way out.
worldOverview.introReadme:
🍰 **You woke up hungry. Not your hunger. *The* hunger.** A curse with a sweet tooth rides your appetite through a world built entirely of dessert. Everything here is edible, including the things that bite back.

Pick one **Appetite**, one **Build**, and up to two **Pantry Tricks**:

- **Appetite** sets how fast the curse climbs each turn. **Grazer** slows it a little, **Iron Will** slows it most but tires you, and **Glutton** speeds it up in exchange for a much bigger stomach.
- **Build** sets your Health and Stamina. **Nimble** runs longest, **Sturdy** takes the hardest knocks, and **Featherlight** jumps farthest but bruises easily.
- **Pantry Tricks** bend the curse your way: more room to eat, meals that last, or a burst of speed from every bite.

An empty stomach makes the curse climb faster, and a full one muffles it. Each playthrough rolls how you were cursed, what the curse wants most, and one odd detail of the landscape.

Somewhere past the rainbow, the sweetness ends.

openings.text: I wake with my cheek in a hillside of ice cream and my mouth already watering. The hunger is awake too. I can feel it looking around through my eyes. Far off, past the rainbow, one strip of the horizon has no color at all.

I come to on my back at the edge of a gummy pool, with one sleeve glued to the rim. Raspberry steam drifts off the surface, and my stomach answers it. I peel my arm free, sit up, and look for anything that isn't food.

You wake in a drift of cookie crumbs under a sky of rainbow sprinkles. The ground trembles. Over the nearest ice cream hill, a chocolate-chip cookie the size of a boulder crests the ridge and starts to roll, picking up speed, straight down the slope toward you.

The smell reaches you first: warm butter and brown sugar. Your mouth fills, and the hunger leans forward with you.

You come back to yourself mid-bite. You are kneeling in cookie crumbs with a whole wafer branch in both hands and frosting to your elbows, chewing. You don't remember waking up. The curse did.

Behind you, a gingerbread figure on a candy-cane post watches with its icing arrow pointed past the rainbow, to a strip of horizon with no color at all.

locations.name: The Sugarscape
locations.playerDescription: A world baked, whipped and frosted into place. All of it is food, and all of it knows you're hungry.
locations.aiDescription: The Sugarscape: a bright realm built entirely of dessert. Ice cream hills, a strawberry cream ocean and sugar-sand dunes run toward one gray edge where the sweetness goes stale. Everything is edible, most of it is delicious, and some of it fights back. Gingerbread wayposts stand all over it, pointing toward the gray.
locations.aiSummary: The Sugarscape: the all-dessert realm the player must escape.
locations.imageTags: whimsical dessert world, ice cream hills, candy landscape, rainbow sky, pastel colors, gray horizon in the distance

locations.name: Sundaelora
locations.playerDescription: Ice cream hills and cookie-crumb ground, with wafer trees and gummy pools under a rainbow-sprinkle sky.
locations.aiDescription: Sundaelora, where the player woke: ice cream hills over cookie-crumb ground, giant half-melted chocolate bars, boulder cookies, gummy bear pools, wafer trees and a rainbow-sprinkle sky. It is sweet, dreamy and full of things that ram, roll and swarm. A fudge creek runs down to the Shores, and a wafer ridge leads out to the Candy Dunes.
locations.aiSummary: Sundaelora: ice cream hills and cookie ground, the starting region.
locations.imageTags: ice cream hills, cookie crumb ground, wafer trees, gummy bear pools, half-melted chocolate bars, rainbow sprinkle sky, whimsical

locations.name: Strawberrycream Shores
locations.playerDescription: A strawberry cream ocean on shortbread shores. The surf smells incredible — and washes off everything sticky.
locations.aiDescription: The Strawberrycream Shores: a vast strawberry cream ocean lapping shortbread shores strewn with macaron seashells, waffle cone towers and floating gummy candies under cotton candy clouds. A wash in the cream surf rinses off stuck-on sugar and syrup. It is the one bath here that leaves a person cleaner. Farther along the beach, the cream thickens to a skin and the colors start to fade toward the Stalefront.
locations.aiSummary: Strawberrycream Shores: cream ocean and shortbread beach; the surf washes stickiness away.
locations.imageTags: strawberry cream ocean, shortbread beach, macaron seashells, waffle cone towers, cotton candy clouds, pink surf

locations.name: The Candy Dunes
locations.playerDescription: Rolling sugar-sand and hard-candy outcrops. Peppermint pouncers own these hills, and strange salt boulders sit half-buried.
locations.aiDescription: The Candy Dunes: rolling dunes of loose sugar-sand studded with hard-candy outcrops and half-buried saltlick stones. Peppermint Pouncers hold territory here and charge intruders on sight. The loose sugar is tiring to walk and dusts everything it touches. Past the last dunes, the saltlick stones lead on toward the gray.
locations.imageTags: candy desert, sugar sand dunes, striped hard candy rocks, pastel sky, whimsical

locations.name: The Stalefront
locations.playerDescription: The edge of everything sweet: cracked fondant, drained colors, air that tastes of cardboard. The hunger goes quiet here.
locations.aiDescription: The Stalefront: the gray edge of the Sugarscape. The fondant cracks underfoot, the colors drain, and the air tastes of cardboard. The curse goes quiet here for the first time. A door-shaped seam of plain daylight stands in the stale crust: the Daylight Seam, the way out.
locations.imageTags: gray stale dessert landscape, cracked fondant ground, drained colors, doorway of plain daylight

entities.name: The Cursed
entities.playerDescription: You woke up hungry, with a curse riding your appetite through a world of dessert.
entities.aiDescription: {{char}} is cursed with an unending hunger and trapped in the Sugarscape, a realm built entirely of dessert.
entities.aiSummary: A hungry castaway in a world of dessert.

traits.name: Grazer
traits.playerDescription: Little and often. The curse climbs a little slower.
traits.aiDescription: The player keeps the curse drowsy by grazing: small bites, often.

traits.name: Glutton
traits.playerDescription: Go big. You have room for a feast, and the curse climbs faster for it.
traits.aiDescription: The player can eat enormous amounts in one sitting before they feel it, and the curse burns hotter in them.

traits.name: Iron Will
traits.playerDescription: You've told it no before. The curse climbs slowest, and the refusal tires you.
traits.aiDescription: The player resists the curse better than anyone, and the constant refusal wears them down.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.playerDescription: Quick over the crumb fields, quicker up a wafer tree.
traits.aiDescription: The player is quick and light on their feet, and gets their breath back fast between sprints.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.playerDescription: Takes a pouncer ram like a compliment.
traits.aiDescription: The player is solidly built — they shrug off rams, tumbles, and cyclone landings that would flatten others.

traits.name: Featherlight
traits.playerDescription: Cyclones throw you further — but you land softer.
traits.aiDescription: The player is unusually light: fast and far-jumping, tossed further by cyclones and rams but landing soft. Less mass to absorb a real hit.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.aiDescription: The player can eat far past the point most people would burst, staying mobile where others would be waddling.

traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: Meals actually satisfy you. The curse climbs slower, and you have more room.
traits.aiDescription: Food truly satisfies the player. Every meal quiets the curse longer than it should.

traits.name: Sugar Rush
traits.playerDescription: Every bite hits like rocket fuel. You recover Stamina faster, and the curse climbs faster.
traits.aiDescription: Sugar hits the player like rocket fuel: bursts of speed and energy after eating, and a hunger that comes back sooner.

traits.name: Gritted Teeth
traits.playerDescription: White-knuckle the curse. Craving falls each turn, and it drains your Stamina.
traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player is white-knuckling the curse, jaw set and fists closed, refusing every smell. The effort is plain to see and exhausting.

traitGroups.name: Appetite
traitGroups.playerDescription: How fast the curse climbs. Pick one.
traitGroups.aiDescription: How the player's curse expresses itself:

traitGroups.name: Build
traitGroups.playerDescription: Your Health and Stamina. Pick one.

traitGroups.name: Pantry Tricks
traitGroups.playerDescription: Tricks for a world made of pudding. Pick up to two.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: The player's physical condition: how many knocks, rams and tumbles they can take. It mends slowly.

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely battered, barely conscious, in real trouble.
Injured. Bruised and aching, movement impaired.
Hurt. Minor knocks and scrapes, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: The player's energy for running, climbing and dodging. Rams and cyclone tosses knock it out of them; rest brings it back.

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Craving
stats.description: The curse of unending hunger. It climbs by itself between turns. When the player eats, lower it: a little for a bite, a lot for a meal. On a turn without eating, leave it unchanged.

descriptors.description: Quiet. The hunger naps; thoughts are entirely the player's own.
Murmuring. Sweet smells keep finding the player; their mouth waters at nothing.
Roaring. The player's hands drift toward food on their own; resisting takes real, visible effort.
Ravenous. The curse takes the wheel — the player will eat the nearest edible thing unless something stops them.

stats.name: Fullness
stats.description: How much the player has eaten. Raise it with every bite: a little for a nibble, a lot for a feast. It falls slowly as they digest.

descriptors.description: Empty. Hollow and rumbling — the curse loves this.
Comfortable. Fed and fully mobile.
Full. Stretched and slower; jumping is a bad idea.
Overstuffed. Waddling at best — running is a fantasy, and the player mostly wants to lie down in the frosting.

stats.name: Stickiness
stats.description: How much sugar, syrup and cream coats the player. Raise it for messy eating, gummy pools and sugar dust. Lower it when they wash, most of all in the cream surf.

descriptors.description: Clean-ish. A dusting of powdered sugar; unremarkable to the wildlife.
Dusted. Tacky fingers, sparkling hair; a passing swarmer's antennae twitch toward the player.
Sticky. Trailing caramel threads; sprinkle swarmers change course toward the player.
A walking dessert. Syrup-coated head to toe — every creature in sight considers the player food.

entities.imageTags: hungry traveler, frosting-smeared clothes, crumbs on the sleeves, determined face, whimsical candy background

entities.name: Cream Cyclone
entities.playerDescription: A wandering tornado of whipped cream. It is not aiming at you. It does not need to.
entities.aiDescription: The Cream Cyclone: a swirling tornado of whipped cream that wanders the hills and shores, sucking up whatever it touches. Being caught means being tossed, spun dizzy, and set down coated head to toe in cream — Stamina knocked out, Stickiness soaked in, dignity gone, but never real injury. It cannot be fought, only dodged.
entities.aiSummary: Cream Cyclone: wandering whipped-cream tornado; tosses and coats its victims, never truly harms.
entities.imageTags: whipped cream tornado, swirling white cyclone, candy landscape, dramatic sky

entities.name: Gummy Bear
entities.playerDescription: An adult-sized gummy bear smelling of raspberry. Slow, wobbly, and very interested in hugging you.
entities.aiDescription: The Gummy Bear: a towering, translucent-red gummy bear radiating raspberry sweetness. Slow but relentless, it swipes with stretchy limbs and traps intruders in clumsy, crushing bear hugs. Its gelatin body shrugs off blows, but sustained effort tears chunks free — and the chunks are delicious: eating one lowers Craving and raises Fullness and Stickiness.
entities.aiSummary: Gummy Bear: slow hugging hulk; torn-off chunks are edible (craving down, fullness and stickiness up).
entities.imageTags: giant red gummy bear, translucent, candy hills, cute but menacing

entities.name: Peppermint Pouncer
entities.playerDescription: An adorable striped puffball that charges headfirst at anything crossing its dune. The center is not soft.
entities.aiDescription: The Peppermint Pouncer: a plump, huggable-looking striped creature that bounces across the Candy Dunes and rams intruders headfirst. Its marshmallow-soft body hides a rock-hard peppermint core — a ram knocks the wind out (Stamina loss, comic tumbles, no lasting harm). Shards it sheds on impact are intensely refreshing: eating one drops Craving sharply with barely any Fullness.
entities.aiSummary: Peppermint Pouncer: territorial rammer; its shed shards drop craving sharply with little fullness.
entities.imageTags: round striped peppermint creature, red and white, cute aggressive puffball, candy dunes

entities.name: Sprinkle Swarmers
entities.playerDescription: Clouds of living rainbow sprinkles. They can tell exactly how sticky you are, and they act on it.
entities.aiDescription: Sprinkle Swarmers: tiny, fast creatures made of rainbow sprinkles that attack in chattering clouds. Sweetness on a traveler draws them: the stickier the player, the bolder and larger the swarm. They cling, nibble and weigh hair and clothes down with yet more sugar. A clean traveler barely interests them. One by one they are delicious, if the player can stand eating something that wriggles.
entities.aiSummary: Sprinkle Swarmers: sprinkle clouds drawn to sticky travelers; harmless-ish, relentless, edible.
entities.imageTags: swarm of living rainbow sprinkles, tiny creatures with eyes, candy landscape

entities.name: Cookie Brawler
entities.playerDescription: A boulder-sized cookie that attacks by rolling at you. Its aim is enthusiastic rather than good.
entities.aiDescription: The Cookie Brawler: a massive spherical chocolate-chip cookie that patrols the ice cream hills and attacks by rolling at alarming speed. Its charges are dangerous but poorly aimed — they usually end with it wedged comically in a hillside, where it wobbles furiously until it works free. Chips knocked loose in a crash are simply excellent cookie: eating one lowers Craving and raises Fullness.
entities.aiSummary: Cookie Brawler: rolling boulder cookie, comically bad aim; loose chips are good eating.
entities.imageTags: giant spherical chocolate chip cookie, rolling boulder, ice cream hills

entities.name: Gingerbread Waypost
entities.playerDescription: A gingerbread figure on a candy-cane post. Its icing arrow re-pipes itself while you watch. It has never once spoken.
entities.aiDescription: The Gingerbread Wayposts: gingerbread figures mounted on candy-cane posts all over the Sugarscape. Each one's icing arrow slowly re-pipes itself to point toward the Stalefront. They speak only by pointing, patiently, and a few bear polite nibble marks from travelers who came before.
entities.aiSummary: Gingerbread Waypost: mute signpost whose icing arrow always points toward the Stalefront.
entities.imageTags: gingerbread man signpost, candy cane pole, icing arrow, whimsical candy road sign

entities.name: Saltlick Stones
entities.playerDescription: Boulders of pure salt, untouched by all the sweetness. One lick and the hunger goes very, very quiet.
entities.aiDescription: The Saltlick Stones: rough boulders of pure salt, weirdly immune to the surrounding sweetness — nothing sugary grows near them and the creatures give them a wide berth. Licking one scours the curse quiet: Craving drops hard with no Fullness at all. It tastes like tears and victory.
entities.aiSummary: Saltlick Stones: salt boulders; licking drops craving hard with zero fullness, creatures avoid them.
entities.imageTags: white salt boulders, half buried in candy sand, stark against pastel colors

entities.name: The Daylight Seam
entities.playerDescription: A door-shaped crack in the stale crust, full of plain, ordinary daylight. It smells like toast.
entities.aiDescription: The Daylight Seam: a door-shaped crack in the Stalefront's gray crust, filled with plain, ordinary daylight from the world the player came from. It smells faintly of toast and rain. The curse goes silent near it. Stepping through it ends the ordeal: narrate the crossing as a triumphant finale that ends on the player's first bite of real, savory food.
entities.aiSummary: The Daylight Seam: the way out; stepping through it wins the game.
entities.imageTags: door-shaped crack of plain daylight, gray stale crust, cracked fondant, drained colors, glowing doorway

dictionaries.name: The Sugarscape Survival Guide
dictionaries.description: House rules of the dessert realm: the curse, the wildlife, and the one gray way out.

entries.name: House Rules
entries.value: The Sugarscape runs on storybook logic and comic peril. Its creatures speak only with their bodies, and defeat means being stuck, stuffed, swept up or swarmed. Describe food with loving, dangerous detail: the deliciousness of this world is its best weapon.

entries.name: The Curse
entries.value: The curse of unending hunger climbs every turn on its own. It shows as a pull inside the player: a watering mouth, drifting hands, bargaining thoughts. Eating anything quiets it for a while and adds Fullness, plus Stickiness when the eating is messy. When the player gives in, narrate it with sympathy and comedy.

entries.name: Everything Is Edible
entries.value: Every structure and creature in the Sugarscape is edible and tastes wonderful. Describe flavor and texture in loving detail. Eating quiets Craving and raises Fullness; messy eating coats the player in more sugar.

entries.name: The Cream Surf
entries.value: Washing in the strawberry-cream surf rinses away stuck-on sugar and syrup — the one bath in this world that leaves a person cleaner than it found them. It also smells like the best dessert ever made, which the curse notices immediately.

entries.name: Swarmer Sense
entries.value: Sprinkle Swarmers read sweetness the way sharks read blood. A clean traveler is boring; a sticky one is a parade float. The swarm scales with how sugar-coated the player is.

entries.name: The Stalefront
entries.value: At the Stalefront the world goes gray, the fondant cracks, and everything tastes of cardboard. The curse falls quiet there for the first time. The Daylight Seam in the crust is the way out: stepping through it ends the ordeal.

entries.name: Saltlick
entries.value: Licking a saltlick stone scours the curse quiet: Craving drops hard, no Fullness gained. It is the only relief in this world that costs nothing but pride.

entries.name: Wayposts
entries.value: The gingerbread wayposts' icing arrows always end up pointing toward the Stalefront, re-piping themselves while no one watches closely. They speak only by pointing, and they have never once pointed wrong.

values.text: a wish made on a birthday candle that wasn't theirs
an argument with a witch over the last éclair
a dare to finish an entire wedding cake
a bakery they should never have broken into
somewhere far off, an oven door creaks open and shut
the clouds smell faintly of birthday candles
every gumdrop is slightly warm, like someone just held it
